statement: Under the independently validated full-port input policy, complementary charts 0 and 7 realize a native retained four-facet correspondence diagram: parent faces, PN permits and geometric memberships are retained; all twelve directed edge selections, twenty-four vertex triple compositions, seventy-two different-edge restriction cells and twenty-four full middle-derivation seams are constructed. This is not an equivalence of complete role domains or a single occupied role frame.
policy: Scoped extraction of the already constructed edge/vertex diagram, with a new fresh headless closure check. Earlier prospective contracts and freezes remain the construction history. This is not presented as a newly blinded experiment.
acceptance: Fresh safe Cubical closure of the actual source-bound four-facet module and edge attachment module, live validated-port source bindings, and rejection of parent-erasure. Retain the separate relational identity/choice limitations.
falsifier: An asserted native selection or restriction cell fails type checking, a full middle attachment is changed, the checked source binding drifts, or complete-domain equivalence is substituted for the stated retained-correspondence scope.
boundary: No automatic parent verdict, total role-domain map, scalar field gluing, physical role motion, whole-space admission or Ramsey forcing.
